assets.name: wallpaper
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square PBR base-color texture for a photorealistic liminal-space exploration game. Create a full-frame orthographic flat scan of aged pale ivory vinyl wallpaper, fine woven embossed fibers and very faint vertical hairline bands, understated 1980s commercial office wall covering. Neutral desaturated warm off-white, exceptionally realistic microscopic material detail, restrained age discoloration, no large stains. Uniform diffuse cross-polarized lighting, NO shadows, NO specular highlights, no perspective, no objects, no borders, no text, no watermark. Seamlessly tileable on all four edges, consistent brightness across entire image. Square 1024x1024 texture, not a room render.

maps.normal: Periodic centered height differences; OpenGL +Y; physical amplitude normalScale=bump/meters; no albedo input
maps.roughness: G channel, material-specific authored multiplier; no legacy compression
maps.ao: Separate R channel, UV channel 0; capped microcavity only, not room occlusion
maps.metalness: constant 0 for paint/glass/rubber; exposed metal .94; no exposed-scratch mask because none is authored
maps.fallback: optional maps null; material constants retained; authored data maps generated locally, no file load
